meta.frame_rule: the exact log's physics state at slice.event_frame (the A2 gate held 0.5 s, the plate 10 cm or more up); pelvis = the floating base; scene frame = the setups' robot frame
meta.body_order: 29 body joints in MJCF order: left leg (6), right leg (6), waist yaw/roll/pitch, left arm (7), right arm (7); fingers in grasp_start.FINGER_JOINTS order
meta.held: the held plate in the holding hand's base frame (rel_pos m, rel_quat wxyz), r_ref = that plate's radius (aabb), fingers = the holding hand at that frame, cmd = its recorded command (the latch target), palm_up_deg = the palm normal (+x of the hand base) from straight up (< 90 = palm facing up)
